This cannot be achieved with add-ons, but as proposed would not try to replace the functionality of logging add-ons or dictate how people handle their own logging, but would enrich the ecosystem for handling debugging information at runtime.

---

This is not work I expect someone else to do for me; if approved, I would be happy to contribute the implementation myself.
answers.workaround:
Both major versions of this change would be non-breaking, and given the buffer-based version is incorporated, it could be gated behind a default-false setting before the buffer is populated. If a setting is used, it would potentially be a great place to also be able to set a severity level, restricting what messages get added to the buffer. For example, 

```gdscript
Engine.error_buffer_enable = Engine.ErrorBuffer.DISABLED # 0, default
Engine.error_buffer_enable = Engine.ErrorBuffer.ERROR # 1
Engine.error_buffer_enable = Engine.ErrorBuffer.WARN # 2, includes errors as well
Engine.error_buffer_enable = Engine.ErrorBuffer.INFO # 3, includes errors and warnings as well
```
